projects.name: CodeBloggs
projects.imageAlt: Illustration of a developer blogging platform with posts, comments, and likes, in navy and cyan
projects.description: A social blogging platform for developers, built as a team MERN application at CodeBoxx. Members register, write posts, comment, like, and browse the network, while admins manage users and content. I later audited its Login and Home pages with Lighthouse, refactored them based on the findings, and added Selenium IDE tests.
